title: One-Shot Federated Model Editing for Device Dynamics at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2610.35212v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard federated learning (FL) requires persistent device connectivity across multiple communication rounds, making it unsuitable for dynamic environments such as vehicular networks, where devices frequently join and leave. One-shot FL offers a promising alternative by completing training in a single communication round. However, one-shot FL suffers from model solidification and cannot readily adapt to subsequent client dynamics, including new client contributions and the withdrawal of previous contributions. We therefore consider exact model editing, which removes withdrawn contributions through unlearning or incorporates newly contributed ones through incremental learning without retraining from scratch. We identify that efficient editing fundamentally hinges on learning stability. To this end, we propose F-SOSA, the first stable one-shot FL algorithm that enables rapid and exact model editing. translated_title: 面向边缘设备动态的一次性联邦模型编辑
translated_abstract: 标准联邦学习（FL）要求设备在多个通信轮次中保持持续连接，因此不适用于车辆网络等动态环境，因为在这类环境中设备会频繁加入和离开。一次性联邦学习（One-shot FL）通过在单次通信轮次内完成训练，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，一次性联邦学习存在模型固化问题，难以适应后续的客户端动态变化，包括新客户端贡献的加入和先前贡献的撤除。因此，我们考虑精确模型编辑，即通过遗忘学习移除撤回的贡献，或通过增量学习纳入新的贡献，而无需从头重新训练。我们发现高效的模型编辑从根本上取决于学习稳定性。为此，我们提出了F-SOSA，这是首个能够实现快速且精确模型编辑的稳定一次性联邦学习算法。F-SOSA利用局部（子采样）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个具备学习稳定性的一次性联邦学习算法F-SOSA，支持快速精确的模型编辑（遗忘与增量学习），使模型无需从头重训即可适应边缘设备频繁加入和离开的动态环境。
en_tdlr: F-SOSA, the first stable one-shot federated learning algorithm, enables rapid and exact model editing (via unlearning and incremental learning) so that models can adapt to edge device dynamics—new client contributions and withdrawn contributions—without retraining from scratch.
